title: Sprint 1 - executor context fidelity
description: SPRINT BRIEF. Fix the channels that deliver the spec to executing agents before touching the directive engine, because these are small additive changes with immediate consumer payoff and no dependency on the refactor. Scope: add spec fields to WorkItemView and every surface that returns it; document the spec-channel contract (description vs evidence vs source) and the paired-work-order hard-block convention; make context packs refresh on every mutating command; make search auto-rebuild instead of failing closed mid-task. Why first: the audit found executors receive only title, status, labels and a one-line contextSummary, which is the strongest internal explanation for brief-shaped work orders drifting. Done when all four tasks close with commit checkpoints and an executor-facing work show returns the full spec.
